Class VisibilityAccessControl

java.lang.Object
io.trino.plugin.base.security.AllowAllAccessControl
org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.security.VisibilityAccessControl
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.trino.spi.connector.ConnectorAccessControl
public final class VisibilityAccessControl extends io.trino.plugin.base.security.AllowAllAccessControl
Connector-level access control that injects a per-row visibility filter on tables carrying a visibility column, enforcing entitlements for ALL Trino consumers of the spatial_iceberg catalog (direct SQL / JDBC / BI), complementing the datastore-layer enforcement used by GeoTools clients.

Allow-all baseline. Every ConnectorAccessControl method DENIES by default, so a connector that installs one is expected to own authorization for the catalog. This feature is purely additive — it must not restrict anything beyond row visibility — so it extends AllowAllAccessControl, reproducing the permissive baseline of Iceberg's (absent) connector access control. Only getRowFilters(ConnectorSecurityContext, SchemaTableName) adds behavior.

The visibility column is detected at analysis time by SpatialConnectorMetadata.getColumnHandles and read here from the shared GeoMesaColumnCatalog. Metadata tables (information_schema, Iceberg $-metadata) are skipped. For any other (data) table that has not been observed, the filter fails closed (hides all rows) rather than risk leaking a vis-bearing table. Boundary: this protects only spatial_iceberg; the plain iceberg catalog is not wrapped and must not be exposed to untrusted users.
